facts.text: I asked for a comparison of the Clinton Era's educational policies to the Obama Era's educational policies.
I asked to highlight the successes and failures of each era's educational policies.
I asked whether anything can be learned from both the Clinton and Obama eras to improve education policy.
I asked what the future of education policy will look like under the current administration.
I said the current administration is putting a strong emphasis on education, especially early childhood education.
I hope the current administration follows through on its promises to make a real difference in the lives of students and educators.
I said education is being prioritized at the national level.
I hope local governments also do their part to ensure their schools receive the support they need to help their students succeed.
I said I am hopeful that collaboration between all stakeholders can lead to real change and improvement in the education system.
I said it is important to prioritize the success and well-being of students.
I said real change is possible if everyone works together.
